# S6.3b — designed causal attribution and judge integrity (`research-grade`) (§05h R-2.9.7 · R-2.10.4⁴ · R-2.7.3⁴ · R-2.12.1⁴)

**Stacked on:** `svitali/harnessharness-s6.3a` (PR #94) · **Do not merge — operator-controlled**

## Summary

Lands Stage 6c's remaining research-grade machinery — the designed
causal-attribution arms (M2 paired counterfactuals under CRN, M3
direct/Shapley effects, M4 mediation, M5), the attribution label
gate that keeps causal claims honest, the judge-integrity closures
(`held_out_from` + `JudgeLeakedIntoArtifact`, monitor
assignment→veto), the critic-experiment value-of-compute row, and
attribution over the evolution lineage DAG. Every leg is
records-in/records-out under matched budget — no new crate edges,
no second store.

**`hh-analysis::attribution` — the M2–M5 kernel.** Two closed
schemata: `hh-attribution-design/1` (methods, targets, estimand,
forks, budget reservation, `noise_coupling`, `attribution_label`)
and `hh-attribution/1` (design ref, subject runs, `effects[]`,
rollouts, spend, truncation, assumptions, coupling, label, reasons,
provenance — deterministic `report_id`). `estimate_rollouts` powers
the design (underpowered ⇒ `UnderpoweredDesign`); `plan` resolves
the factual arm + counterfactual forks (`replay`, `toggle_locus`,
`ablate_locus`, `resample_exogenous`, `mediate`) per (target,
fork-point); `attribute` executes and emits per-(target,
fork-point) `effects[]` with `effect_kind` ∈ {`paired_te`,
`counterfactual_te`, `crn_te`, `de`, `ie`, `shapley`} +
`uncertainty_ppm`; `locus` reports `point_of_commitment` and
`earliest_direct` separately — never resolved into one; and
`attribution_quality` folds `uncoupled_share` / `label` /
`label_ceiling` / `unattributed_share`. `noise_coupling = crn`
couples both arms at the exogenous draw (`coupled_evidence`);
uncoupled sources are typed `UncoupledSource` refusals, never
dropped (KA-I7-2). The `attribution_label` ceiling is the
admissibility floor — `LABEL_METHOD_FLOORS` (M1 → `designed_
ablation`, M2/M4/M5 → `causal_interventional`, M3 → `causal_
coupled`) — and confirmatory may only downgrade on degraded
validity (KA-I7-6/13/14).

**The S2 `attribution_ref` link + `TargetMismatch`.**
`FailureHypothesis.attribution_ref` binds the hypothesis to a
deposited `hh-attribution-design/1`. At `hypothesize`, a hypothesis
whose `semantic_op_targets` is non-empty must name it — absent ⇒
`AttributionMissing`, unresolvable/wrong-schema ⇒
`AttributionReportInvalid`, design targets not covering a semantic
op ⇒ `TargetMismatch` (KA-I7-12). The gate reads the *designed
claim*, not the raw diff — mechanical-diff hypotheses keep the
landed path (ADR-0324 D1); the `hypothesized` transition row
carries `attribution_ref` (CC8).

**The S5 label gate.** A hypothesis that named `attribution_ref`
deposits its `hh-attribution/1` report at S5:
`attribution_report_ref` must resolve to the right schema, the
report's `design_ref` must equal the hypothesis's
`attribution_ref`, `attribution_label` must sit in the closed
ladder, and a `locality` claim requires ≥
`causal_interventional` (M1's `designed_ablation` carries no
locus). Member-level reads at the campaign boundary — no new
`hh-evolution` → `hh-analysis` edge (D4).

**Judge integrity (R-2.7.3⁴).**
`JudgePolicy.artifact_benefit_selector` declares
`held_out_from`; an S5 `artifact_benefit` naming a selector inside
its own closure refuses `JudgeLeakedIntoArtifact` — the durable
mirror of hh-verification's boundary check.
`SelectorDeclaration` gains `kind ∈ {judge, monitor}` +
`adversarial`; a monitor must declare `adversarial ∈
{trusted_weaker, untrusted_monitored}` (`untrusted_unmonitored` or
missing ⇒ `MonitorSelectorInadmissible` at `spec.validate`,
§8.1). `monitor_assign` mints `measurement.evolution.monitor.
assigned` and `monitor_veto` mints `…monitor.veto` +
`rejected{monitor_vetoed}` — a veto with no prior assignment row
never counts, and a monitor is never a vote (D2). The new classes
register audit-grade kernel-origin (`MONITOR_FIELDS`).

**Value of compute (R-2.10.4⁴).**
`hh_eval::critic_experiment::placement_row` folds the {`critic_off`,
`critic_on`} outcome into `hh-critic-placement-row/1` — the
`PlacementFact` member set verbatim: `rates` from the critic-on
arm's absolute cells, `verification_overhead` the on−off delta
(the critic's marginal cost), `calibration_status`/`uncaught_cost`
declared inputs, `removal_test` the experiment's own
`critic_experiment:{critic_ref}:{placement}` handle; the boundary
decodes it into `ComputeFacts` records-in (D5). Undeclared metrics
refuse `UndeclaredMetricDropped` — never silently dropped.

**The lineage DAG (R-2.12.1⁴).** `hh_evolution::lineage` folds
the view's candidate records into `LineageDag` — rejected
candidates stay nodes; a candidate's `base_ref` resolves to the
earlier-registered candidate whose `target_ref` it equals (the
campaign base is the root); `CampaignView` tracks the lineage head
through activation and reversion. `attribute_lineage` composes
the deposited reports: per-node `edge_effect` (signed sum of
`effects[].point`), `edge_share_ppm` over the lineage-wide
|effect| mass, `reported = false` for nodes without a report —
measured shares, never a decomposition claim (D6).

**Boundary.** `lab.attribution.{design, attribute, locus,
quality}` + `lab.analysis.attribution_design` join Group L
(`serves_measurement`, experimental, ANALYSIS_ERR); Group-W
`counterfactual` admits `noise_coupling = "crn"`. Schema, compat
matrix, and generated client regenerated through `hh-codegen`
(CC7).

## Test plan

- `hh-analysis --test s6_3b` — **12/12** (KA-I7 battery: CRN
  paired effects + `coupled_evidence`, `UncoupledSource` refusals,
  `locus` both measures, `estimate_rollouts`/`UnderpoweredDesign`,
  the label→method floor, counterfactual TE under the KA-I7
  fixture, policy-collapse/authority-widening refusals,
  `unattributed_share`/`uncoupled_share`/`label_ceiling`, `n/a`
  hosted rendering).
- `hh-evolution --test s6_3b` — the S2/S5 attribution battery
  (`attribution_ref` link, unresolvable/wrong-schema/
  `TargetMismatch` legs, the locality label gate), monitor
  selectors + the assigned→veto ordering,
  `JudgeLeakedIntoArtifact`, lineage DAG + `attribute_lineage`
  legs.
- `hh-evolution --test s6_1a` / `s6_2` / `s6_3a` — landed
  batteries green on threaded literals.
- `hh-embed --test s6_3b` — the `lab.attribution.*` op legs
  (declared-op, strict decode, typed errors, CRN admission at
  Group-W `counterfactual`).
- `hh-eval` — `critic_experiment_reports_five_deltas_under_
  matchspec` + `critic_experiment_placement_row_folds_the_value_
  of_compute_row`.
- `cargo test --workspace` — see `docs/build/runs/S6.3b.md`
